name: Stabilized Black Pudding

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-06: Signal from the Electric Laboratory

items.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
items.text: A black pudding can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

items.name: Corrosive Mass
items.text: A creature that hits the pudding with a metal or wooden weapon must succeed at a DC 22 Reflex save save or the weapon takes 2d6 acid damage (after dealing damage to the black pudding as normal). Thrown weapons and ammunition take this damage automatically with no save.

items.name: Splorch
items.text:
Trigger An adjacent creature hits the black pudding jelly with a Strike that would deal slashing or piercing damage

Effect A gout of acidic jelly shoots out at the attacker. The attacker must attempt a DC 25 Reflex save save.

---

Critical Success The attacker is unaffected.

Success The attacker takes 1d8 acid damage.

Failure The attacker takes 2d8 acid damage.

Critical Failure The attacker takes 2d8 acid damage and 4 persistent acid damage.

items.name: Constrict
items.text:
1d8+7 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 acid damage, DC 26 basic Fortitude save save

---

items.name: Corrosive Touch
items.text: When the pudding hits a creature with its pseudopod, any acid damage is dealt to the creature's armor or clothing as well as the creature.

items.name: Suction
items.text: The pudding can climb on ceilings and other inverted surfaces, though such surfaces are difficult terrain for it.

text: Slimes, molds, and other oozes can be found in dank dungeons and shadowed forests. While not necessarily evil, some grow to enormous sizes and have insatiable appetites.
